citation.text: Price MN, Wetmore KM, Waters RJ, et al. Mutant phenotypes for thousands of bacterial genes of unknown function. Nature 2018;557:503-509. Data from the Fitness Browser (https://fit.genomics.lbl.gov/), organism SynE.

units: gene fitness (log2 ratio of barcode abundance at the end of the experiment to the Time0 sample, Wetmore et al. 2015), as published by the Fitness Browser

replicates.text: one RB-TnSeq mutant library, SynE_ML6, across four experiment sets; the experiment table does not state whether experiments repeated at one condition set are biological or technical replicates
